messages:
carmen: Quick sync request from Sprinter: they want a co-branded smokebench next week focused on perf/W (tokens/J), sustained throughput, and a small kernel instrumentation pass. Who can own what? cc @leo @tara
leo: I can take results presentation + marketing copy. tara: I'll own test harness and workload selection. propose models: gpt-mini-open + gpt-medium-open, seq lens [64,128,512], batches [1,4]. keep single replica for baseline.
deepti: I'll do infra/telemetry. need partner VPN, container images, and permission to run perf on nodes (kernel headers). how many nodes do we need?
mike: For kernel probes, I can instrument matmul, attention softmax, and memcpy hotspots. also want PMU counters: cycles, LLC-load-misses, mem_load_uops_retired.l1_miss. we'll do one detailed trace after smoke.
carmen: timeline note: Sprinter wants preliminary numbers by next Friday for a joint announcement window. can we deliver smoke + one kernel trace by then?
deepti: smoke + one trace is doable if we get access by Tue. reserving 2x80GB GPUs now. will put up isolated VLAN and s3 bucket.
leo: success metrics idea: tokens/J >= 20% uplift over our baseline OR p99 latency within 15% of baseline. also flag if any kernel path regresses.
tara: testcases: include warm and cold KV-cache startup. if Sprinter can share a KV snapshot that'd be great; otherwise we'll generate using a synthetic warmup.
mike: note: quantization (INT8) changes kernel choices a lot. recommend doing FP16 smoke first, then INT8 follow-up if partner wants.
bench-bot: job scheduled: job_id=sb-2026-03-18-14, dashboard=https://benchboard.redwood/sb-2026-03-18-14
bench-bot: queued command:
```
./bench/run --model gpt-medium-open --batch 4 --seq 128 --profile perf_w --mode smoke --out sb-2026-03-18-14
```
deepti: requesting Sprinter contact info (Clara) and SSO/service account for runner. emailed Clara just now.
mike: prepping perf script: `perf record -e cycles,LLC-load-misses -o perf.data -- ./run_workload` and small flamegraph postproc. will share script tomorrow.
leo: I'll draft a 1-page partner brief (scope, timelines, embargo, sign-off owners) and a 1-slide teaser for comms. will post for comment by EOD.
carmen: owners recap: infra=deepti, kernel/microprof=mike, harness=testcases=tara, marketing=leo, overall=carmen. please keep sensitive links out of channel.
bench-bot: smoke partial results posted: https://benchboard.redwood/runs/sb-2026-03-18-14/results
bench-bot: snippet:
```
config,batch,seq,throughput,tk_per_joule,p99_ms
baseline,1,64,290 req/s,0.40 tok/J,130 ms
sprinter-opt,1,64,350 req/s,0.56 tok/J,125 ms
```
tara: nice token/J lift. Deepti: can you export the raw perf bundle for Mike?
deepti: exporting to s3://redwood-partners/sprinter/sb-2026-03-18-14/perf_bundle.tar.gz and shared with Clara.
mike: received, starting trace analysis. I'll produce a small heatmap and call out top 3 hotspots.
leo: scheduled follow-up sync with Sprinter Tuesday 9am PT. agenda: VPN, handoff, review smoke charts, sign-off path. invite incoming. :calendar:
